content.value: i) What should be the pulse repetition frequency of a radar in order to achieve a (12) maximum unambiguous range of 60 nmi?
ii) How long does it take for the radar signal to travel Qut and back when the target is at the maximum unambiguous range?
iii) If the radar has a pulse width of 1.5 μs, what is the extent (in meters) of the pulse energy in space in the range coordinate?
